title: Alice Shop E-commerce
descr: A Nuxt 3 storefront-style ecommerce application built with Vue, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Shopify Storefront API. It includes collection and product pages, GraphQL-powered catalog data, Shopify customer authentication, theme switching, and an animated branded landing experience.

stack.Authentication: Shopify customer authentication with OAuth PKCE

flow: The app presents a branded ecommerce landing page and lets customers browse collections, categories, and product pages. Product and collection data is loaded from Shopify through GraphQL queries. Pinia manages product-related state, while Shopify customer authentication handles account access through an OAuth PKCE flow. The Nuxt layout provides shared navigation and theme switching across the storefront.
